prompts.text: The Jesuit tradition at Xavier University emphasizes the Magis, the call to do more for others in the pursuit of justice, compassion, and excellence. Describe how one of your lived experiences aligns with this value and how this has informed your desire to pursue medicine at the Xavier University College of Osteopathic Medicine.

The Osteopathic philosophy and the Jesuit principle of cura personalis both emphasize treating the whole person-- mind, body, and spirit. Describe a concrete example of how your experience aligns with this value, and how has this informed your desire to pursue Osteopathic Medicine.

The path to medicine often demands careful discernment in the face of adversity. Share a significant challenge you have faced, how you reflected on that experience, and how it strengthened your resilience and commitment to becoming a physician.
